template.subject: USERREMINDER_REMINDER_DETAILS_FOR
template.htmlbody:
Hello {NAME},

You registered an account at {SITENAME}, but it has not been activated yet.

Activate your account with this link:
{ACTIVATE_URL}

After that, log in with your username {USERNAME}. Forgot your password? Reset it here.

If you did not register at {SITENAME}, you can ignore this email.

Regards,
{SITENAME}
{SITELINK}

Do not want to receive these reminders? Unsubscribe.
